requirements.definition: An access-spec in an enumeration header specifies the type name's accessibility and the enumerators' default accessibility. An enumerator's access can be confirmed or overridden by a separate access statement. If the header has no access-spec, the normal module accessibility rules still apply; there is no unconditional PUBLIC default overriding a module PRIVATE statement.
